title: Study to Refine the Effectiveness of New Generation Therapies for Suicide
official: STRENGTHENS: Study To Refine the Effectiveness of New Generation Therapies for Suicide
summary: The purpose of this research study is to improve the effectiveness of a well-established therapy for suicidal thoughts and behaviors called Brief Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (BCBT) for Suicide Prevention.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years of age or older
* Suicidal ideation and/or suicidal behavior within the past month or a total score on the Suicide Cognitions Scale-Revised \>21
* Psychiatric hospitalization for elevated suicide risk within the past month
* Able to understand and speak the English language
* Able to complete the informed consent process

Exclusion Criteria:

* Impaired mental status that precludes the ability to provide informed consent (e.g., intoxication, psychosis, mania)
* A medical or psychiatric condition that precludes the ability to engage in outpatient therapy

sites.f: Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Health
